parameters.name: categoryId
parameters.description: Leaf category id for `/browse` (must be a **leaf**  -  `isLeaf:true` in `/category-navigation`; intermediate categories return no results). e.g. `9580` = apartment sales, `10920` = apartment rentals, `15037` = Google Pixel phones. Note: full-text `/search` does **not** support category filtering  -  use `/browse` to scope by category.
